_comment: Slow, escalating wrongness through the shift. Progress values are 0..1 of the shift elapsed.

lightsOut._comment: Ceiling lights die from the far edge of the office towards the player's desk.

chairs._comment: Empty chairs in the open aisles. While the player faces the screen, more of them turn to face the player's cubicle.

echo._comment: Someone else's keyboard answers the player's keystrokes, a beat late, from behind. It starts far away and comes closer.

r12._comment: The previous operator's log. Appears on the desktop after the first look-away and gains a line about tonight with each one after.
r12.title: R12.txt
